Boma la Dziko la Zambia vs Banthu a Banja la Lungu & Ena ankakhala nkhani ya malamulo yomwe inamvetseredwa ku High Court ya South Africa, Gawo la Gauteng, ku Pretoria, mu 2025.
Nkhaniyi inachitika pothi mtsogoleri wakale wa Zambia Edgar Lungu akufa, yemwe adapita ku South Africa mu June 2025.
Pafika kusowa kwa kumvetsetsa pakati pa boma la Zambia ndi mamembala a banja la Lungu zokhudza malo ndi malamulo a kuchita mwambo wake woponya mtembo.
Banja lidafotokozera chikhumbo chawo chokhala ndi mwambo wosakhala wamba ku South Africa ndipo silikufuna kuti mtsogoleri waposachedwa Hakainde Hichilema athe kuchita nawo mwambo wa kumwalira.
Komabe, boma la Zambia linkafuna kubweretsa thupi ku Zambia ndi kuchita mwambo wa dziko ndi ulemu wonse ku Embassy Park, malo achinsinsi a anthu omwe amakhala atsogoleri.
Pa 8 August 2025, Khoti Lalikulu linapereka chigamulo chifukwa cha boma la Zambia, likupereka kuti pali mgwirizano wovomerezeka pakati pa mbalizi ziwiri pochitira kubwezetsa ndi kumukweza munthu wa boma.
Khoti linalimbikitsa kuti, malinga ndi malamulo a Zambia komanso malinga ndi malamulo a anthu, chinthu chachikulu cha dziko pakulemekeza mtsogoleri wamakono wa dziko chimaposa zonena za munthu wafa kapena banja lake.
Akhothi anapitiliza kuyika malamulo kuti thupi la Lungu liperekedwe mwamsanga kwa oyang'anira a ku Zambia kuti libweredwe kunyumba ndi kuloweredwa ku Lusaka.
Dame Katherine Patricia Routledge (17 February 1929 – 3 October 2025) anali wosewera ndi woyimba wochokera ku England.
Anadziwika kwambiri chifukwa cha udindo wake woseketsa ngati Hyacinth Bucket mu sitcom ya BBC yotchedwa Keeping Up Appearances (1990–1995), yomwe m’kati mwake adayambitsanso ku BAFTA TV Award kawiri m’gulu la Best Light Entertainment Performance.
Routledge adayamba kusewera pa gulu lazamasewera ku Liverpool Playhouse mu 1952 ndi kudziwika ku West End mu The Love Doctor mu 1959.
Pochita debut mu Broadway mu How's the World Treating You mu 1966, anapeza Tony Award ya 1968 ya Best Actress in a Musical chifukwa cha udindo wake mu Darling of the Day.
Analandira 1988 Olivier Award ya Best Actress in a Musical chifukwa cha Candide pa Old Vic.
M'mayeso ake mu mafilimu akuphatikizapo To Sir, with Love (1967) ndi Don't Raise the Bridge, Lower the River (1968).
Martin Gerard James Neary LVO (28 Marichi 1940 – 27 Seputembala 2025) anali wosewera nthawi zonse wa organi komanso mtsogoleri wa nyimbo za m’dera.
Anali master wa nyimbo ku Winchester Cathedral kuyambira 1972 mpaka 1988, ndipo anali organista komanso master wa ma choristers ku Westminster Abbey kuyambira 1988 mpaka 1998.
Anapempha ntchito zatsopano kwa opanga nyimbo kuphatikizapo Jonathan Harvey ndi John Tavener.
Mu 1997 anali director wa nyimbo pa utumiki waufunu wa Princess Diana.
Girls' Generation ( Korean : 소녀시대 ; RR : Sonyeo Sidae ), yemwenso amadziwika kuti SNSD , ndi gulu la atsikana aku South Korea lopangidwa ndi SM Entertainment.
Gululi lili ndi mamembala asanu ndi atatu: Taeyeon, Sunny, Tiffany, Hyoyeon, Yuri, Sooyoung, Yuna, ndi Sohyun.
Ngakhale kuti poyamba gululi linali ndi mamembala asanu ndi anayi, mamembala asanu ndi atatu otsalawo akhalabe gululo kuyambira pamene Jessica adasiya gululo ku 2014.
Atsikana a Generation adayamba ku South Korea ndi album yawo yoyamba ku 2007.
Komabe, sizinali mpaka kutulutsidwa kwa "G" yawo imodzi mu 2009 kuti adapeza chidwi chachikulu.
Nyimboyi idakwera pamwamba pa tchati cha KBS Music Bank kwa milungu isanu ndi inayi yotsatizana, ndikuphwanya zolemba zonse zam'mbuyomu.
Inatchedwa nyimbo yotchuka kwambiri m'zaka za m'ma 2000 ku South Korea ndi wofalitsa nyimbo pa intaneti Melon.
Girls' Generation pambuyo pake idatulutsa nyimbo zingapo zodziwika bwino, kuphatikiza "Tell Me Your Wish (Genie)", "Oh!" ndi "Run Devil Run".
Nyimbozi zidadziwika kwambiri kuyambira pakati pa 2009 mpaka koyambirira kwa 2010.
Emmily Kamwendo-Naphambo ndi katswiri wa chikhalidwe cha anthu ku Malawi ndipo akatswiri azachitukuko omwe amagwira ntchito yothandiza anthu-chitukuko-mtendere ku Africa konse.
Ntchito yake imayang'ana pa kufanana pakati pa amuna ndi akazi, kuteteza ana, komanso thanzi la anthu.
Pakadali pano ndi Wachiwiri kwa Woyimira wa United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA) ku Ghana.
Mbiri Yamaphunziro
Poyamba a ku Malawi, ntchito ya Emily yophunzira yakhala ikufotokoza za malamulo ndi chikhalidwe cha anthu ovutika.
Iye analandira digiri ya master mu maphunziro chitukuko ku University Lund mu 2009.
Ntchito yake yotchedwa "Andende Osaoneka" inayang'ana za kupezeka ndi zochitika za ana m'ndende za ku Malawi.
Mu 2020, adamaliza digiri yake ya PhD mu Sociology ku University of Cape Town (UCT).
Kafukufuku wake wa udokotala.
womwe unathandizidwa ndi African Pathways Scholarship, ndi ndalama zochokera ku National Institute for the Humanities and Social Sciences (NIHSS) ndi Council for the Development of Social Science Research in Africa (CODESRIA) adafufuza momwe miyambo ya chikhalidwe ndi chikhalidwe imafotokozera kukonzekera ukwati pakati pa atsikana achichepere.
Naphambo anayamba ntchito yake ndi Population Services International yomwe imayang'ana kwambiri pakusintha malamulo a chikhalidwe cha anthu komanso kutenga nawo mbali kwa achinyamata.
Pambuyo pake adathandizira pa kafukufuku wapadziko lonse polemba nawo mutu wa "Women Empowerment" mu kafukufuku wa 2016 Malawi demographic and Health Survey mogwirizana ndi bungwe la National Statistics Office .
Ntchito yake inaphatikizapo maudindo angapo okhudza kusintha kwa malamulo ndi chikhalidwe cha anthu;
Kulimbikitsa Ukwati wa Ana : Ali mu Plan International, iye anatsogolera Plan 18+ yothetsa maukwati a ana ku Malawi, Tanzania, Zambia ndi Zimbabwe, ndi cholinga chokweza zaka zovomerezeka za ukwati kuchokera pa 15 kufika pa 18.
Secretariat ya United Nations : Anagwira ntchito ku United Nations Mission In South Sudan mu 2019, komwe adagwirizanitsa ntchito zoteteza ana zokhudzana ndi asilikali panthawi ya Nkhondo Yapachiweniweni ku South Sudan ndipo adatsogolera kulembedwa kwa malipoti a bungwe lachitetezo okhudza ana ndi nkhondo.
Pa udindo wake waposachedwa monga Wachiwiri kwa Woyimira wa United Nations Population Fund ku Ghana , adapita kunja kwa dzikolo mapulogalamu okhudzana ndi thanzi la amayi, ufulu wobereka achinyamata, komanso kuchepetsa nkhanza zokhudzana ndi amuna ndi akazi.
Kafukufuku ndi Mabuku
Kafukufuku wa Naphambo nthawi zambiri amafufuza momwe ulamuliro wachikhalidwe ndi ufulu wa anthu zimagwirizanirana.
Kafukufuku wake wa 2022 mu Journal of Adolescent Health adasanthula momwe mafumu akumidzi amakhudzira mphamvu za atsikana pakugonana komanso mphamvu za anthu onse.
Ntchito yake yoyambirira ndi Women and Law in Southern Africa (WSLA) inapangitsa kuti lipoti la "Poor, Invisible and Excluded: Women in State Custody Malawi" lilembe za malamulo ndi moyo wa akazi omwe ali m'ndende.
Iye wathandizanso pa pepala lothandizira la UNFPA - UNICEF lotchedwa Towards Zero Gender-Based Violence and Harmful Practices in West and Central Africa .
Iye walembanso mfundo zachidule za South African Development Community (SADC) zokhudzana ndi mgwirizano wa malamulo a dziko ndi African Charter on Rights and Welfare of the Child .

Pratyush Shivam ndi katswiri wa zamatekinoloje (CTO) komanso wamalonda wapadziko lonse.
Iye amadziwika kwambiri chifukwa cha udindo wake monga Chief Technology Officer ku TrustedTrucks, nsanja yotsogola ya blockchain yomwe ili ku Berlin, Germany.
Ntchito ya Padziko Lonse
Shivam amatsogolera luso lazaumisiri ku TrustedTrucks, yomwe inayambitsidwa ndi mgwirizano pakati pa ZUFALL logistics group ndi Konfidio ku Germany.
Ntchito yake imathandiza makampani oyendetsa katundu ku Ulaya kukhala ndi chitetezo chamakono kudzera mu blockchain.
Ku Mumbai, India, Shivam ndiye woyambitsa nawo kampani ya Keisang HR Private Limited.
Iye amagwiritsa ntchito luso lake lamakono pofuna kupititsa patsogolo ntchito yolemba anthu ntchito kudzera mu dongosolo la Keisang Awards & Certifications (KAC).
Sarkari VLE ndi nsanja ya pa intaneti ya ku India yomwe imafalitsa zambiri zokhudza ntchito za boma, mapulani a boma, zotsatira za mayeso, admit card, ndi ntchito zina za pa intaneti.
Cholinga cha nsanjayi ndi kuthandiza ophunzira, ofuna ntchito, ndi nzika kumvetsa zambiri za boma m’njira yosavuta.
Sarkari VLE imayang’ana kwambiri pa kufalitsa zambiri zokhudza:
Zilengezo za ntchito za boma
Mapulani a thandizo la boma
Zotsatira za mayeso ndi admit card
Kalozera wa kulemba mafomu pa intaneti

Yamaha Motor Company (Yamaha Hatsudoki), ndi kampani yopanga magalimoto ochokera m'mayiko osiyanasiyana ku Japan yomwe ili ndi likulu lake ku Iwata City, Shizuoka Prefecture.
Kampaniyo imagwira ntchito m'maiko ndi madera pafupifupi 180, ndi madera amalonda kuphatikizapo njinga zamoto, ma scooter, maboti, injini za ndege, ndi maloboti.
Ndi kampani yachiwiri padziko lonse yopanga njinga zamoto komanso yopanga maboti akuluakulu padziko lonse lapansi JETRONikkei.
Kampaniyi ndi yosiyana kwambiri ndi kampani yopanga zida za nyimbo ya Yamaha ( Hamamatsu, Shizuoka ).
Lamulo la Constitution of Zambia (Amendment) Act, Nambala 7 la 2025 (lomwe nthawi zambiri limatchedwa Bill 7) ndi lamulo losintha malamulo a dziko la Zambia lomwe linakhazikitsidwa pambuyo poti Nyumba Yamalamulo ya dziko la Zambia yavomerezedwa pa 15 Disembala 2025 ndipo lavomerezedwa ndi Purezidenti Hakainde Hichilema pa 18 Disembala 2025.
Lamuloli likusintha magawo angapo a Constitution of Zambia, pokambirana nkhani zokhudzana ndi kapangidwe ka Nyumba Yamalamulo ya dziko, makonzedwe a zisankho, njira zosankhidwira anthu, ndi zina zokhudzana ndi ulamuliro.
Lamuloli lidayambitsidwa koyamba mu Meyi 2025 ndi Unduna wa Zachilungamo ndipo lidayambitsa mkangano waukulu wadziko lonse komanso kutsutsa kuchokera ku mabungwe a anthu wamba, zipani zandale zotsutsa, ndi mabungwe aukadaulo, omwe adadzutsa nkhawa zokhudzana ndi kufunika kwake komanso njira yomwe idagwiritsidwa ntchito popanga malamulo.
Pa 27 Juni 2025, Khothi Lalikulu la Dziko la Zambia linalengeza kuti lamuloli silikugwirizana ndi malamulo a dziko, ndipo linagamula kuti silikutsatira Nkhani 79 ya Constitution, yomwe imafuna kuti anthu ambiri akambirane za kusintha kwa malamulo a dzikolo asanayambe.
Pambuyo pa chigamulo cha Khothi, boma linayambitsa njira yowunikiranso kudzera mu kusankhidwa kwa Komiti Yaukadaulo Yokhudza Kusintha kwa Malamulo Oyendetsera Dziko.
Pambuyo pa zokambirana za dziko lonse ndi kusintha malamulo ena, Lamuloli linabweretsedwanso ku Nyumba Yamalamulo.
Pa 15 Disembala 2025, Nyumba Yamalamulo idavomereza Lamuloli losinthidwa pa Kuwerenga Kwake Kachitatu pambuyo poti lapeza ambiri omwe amafunikira malinga ndi malamulo oyendetsera dziko, ndipo aphungu 135 a Nyumba Yamalamulo adavota ndipo palibe amene adavota kapena kukana.
Lamuloli linayamba kugwira ntchito purezidenti atavomereza pa 18 Disembala 2025.
Atasaina, Hichilema anati: “Tsopano popeza ndi lamulo, ndikulengeza kuti mkanganowu watha.
Zolinga za Bill
Zolinga za Bill iyi ndikusintha Constitution ya Zambia kuti:
(a) kusintha kapangidwe ka Nyumba Yamalamulo kuti pakhale kuwonjezeka kwa mipando yochokera kumadera osiyanasiyana kuchoka pa 156 kufika pa 211 kuti lipoti la Electoral Commission likwaniritse malire;
(b) kusintha njira yosankhidwa ya chisankho ku Nyumba Yamalamulo kuti pakhale njira yosankhidwa ya mamembala osiyanasiyana kuti atsimikizire kuti akazi, achinyamata, ndi anthu olumala akuyimira;
(c) kusintha gawo lokhudzana ndi kulembetsa mayina atsopano pakusiya ntchito kwa wopikisana;
(d) kusintha malamulo okhudzana ndi zisankho zapakati;
(e) kusintha chiwerengero cha mamembala osankhidwa a Nyumba Yamalamulo;
(f) kugwirizanitsa nthawi ya Nyumba Yamalamulo ndi khonsolo kuti pakhale nthawi ya zaka zisanu;
(g) kupereka malo opanda anthu mu ofesi ya Nduna ndi Nduna ya Zigawo masiku makumi asanu ndi anayi chisankho chachikulu chisanachitike;
(h) kuchotsa malire a nthawi ziwiri a udindo wa meya ndi wapampando wa khonsolo;
(i) kusintha kapangidwe ka bungwe kuti kaphatikizepo aphungu a Nyumba Yamalamulo omwe ali ndi mipando yochokera kumadera osiyanasiyana;
(j) kusintha ziyeneretso zosankhidwa kukhala mlembi wa nduna;
(k) kupatsa Loya Wamkulu ndi Loya Wamkulu mwayi wopitiliza kugwira ntchito pambuyo pa chisankho chachikulu mpaka anthu atsopano atasankhidwa;
(l) kusintha tanthauzo la mawu oti "mwana" ndi "wamkulu";
(m) kupereka momveka bwino nthawi yomwe pempho la chisankho lidzamalizidwe; ndi
(n) kupereka nkhani zokhudzana ndi, kapena zokhudzana ndi, zomwe zili pamwambapa.
thumb Chifaniziro cha Zhuhai Fisher Girl chomwe adachimanga mu 1982, chakhala chikuwonetsedwa kwa nthawi yayitali.
Ndi chachitali mamita 8.7 ndipo chili ndi miyala ya granite 70.
Chifanizirochi chili ngati chizindikiro chachikulu cha mzinda wa Zhuhai.
Zhuhai Fisher Girl (Chitchaina: 珠海渔女; pinyin: Zhūhǎi Yú Nǚ) ndi chifaniziro komanso malo odziwika bwino m'dera la Xianglu Bay zh ku Zhuhai ku Guangdong, China.
Chifanizirochi, chomwe chinapangidwa chisanakhazikitsidwe Zhuhai Special Economic Zone, chinapangidwa ndi Pan He kutengera nthano ya m'deralo yokhudza cholengedwa chakumwamba chomwe chinatsikira kuderali kukakhala ngati msodzi wamba.
Ngakhale kuti mtengo wake unali wotsutsana, chifanizirochi chinamalizidwa mu 1982 ndipo chinakhala gawo la makampani okopa alendo omwe akukula m'derali.
Chifanizirochi chinasankhidwa kukhala chosungiramo zachikhalidwe mu 2014, ndipo chaka chotsatira wosemayo adamaliza ntchito yogwirizana ndi mwana wake wamwamuna yomwe ikuwonetsa mtsikana wosodzayo ngati mayi.
Pakhala lingaliro lokulitsa malo ozungulira chifanizirocho kukhala malo osangalalira osiyanasiyana.
Josh Akumenyana zinali zodziwika bwino pa intaneti, ndewu yongopeka, komanso kusonkhetsa ndalama zothandizira anthu osowa ku Air Park ku Lincoln, Nebraska, pa Epulo 24, 2021, ndipo chochitika chachiwirichi chinachitika ku Bowling Lake Park ku Lincoln pa Meyi 21, 2022.
Chochitikachi chinayambitsidwa ndi wophunzira wa zomangamanga dzina lake Josh Swain wochokera ku Tucson, Arizona, pa Epulo 24, 2020, chifukwa chotopa panthawi ya COVID-19 lockdown.
Chinatchuka kwambiri pambuyo poti chithunzi cha Facebook Messenger cha gulu la anthu chomwe chinali ndi ogwiritsa ntchito angapo otchedwa Josh Swain chinafalikira kwambiri pa intaneti.
Swain analimbikitsa ophunzira kuti akumane pagulu la anthu chaka chimodzi kenako n’kumenyera ufulu wogwiritsa ntchito dzina lakuti "Josh".
Chochitikachi, ngakhale poyamba chinali nthabwala, chinakopa anthu pafupifupi chikwi pa tsiku la chochitikachi.
Msonkhanowu unali wopepuka ndipo panalibe chiwawa chenicheni chomwe chinachitika.
Nyuzipepala ya Wall Street Journal inalemba kuti chochitikachi chinakhala "chochitika cha nkhani zapadziko lonse," pomwe wolemba zaukadaulo wa The Guardian anati "mwina yankho lalikulu kwa munthu wogwiritsa ntchito intaneti molakwika".
